attrs.evidence: None. The CHECKABLE half of GPT-5.6's ADMISSION-SUPPORT-CLOSED, split out at R7.3 so that a green gate cannot be mistaken for a discharged architecture. This half is a predicate over the transition record at admission time and is decidable from the record alone: collect the SupportRefs the transition used, check each is sealed, refuse otherwise. It is the half a gate can run, and it is also the half that establishes nothing about completeness — a transition that used one reference and sealed it is sealed, whatever else it read.
attrs.gap: Nothing in this tree mediates anything, so nothing produces a SupportRef and nothing seals one. The rule has a form and no subject.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, on ROUND7_2_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §8.1. SRC-SALTZER-1975-MEDIATION for the always-checked form; SRC-ANDERSON-1972-REFMON for `always invoked` as one of four separate requirements rather than a single property.

readjudicated.method: question_survives — an OPEN claim asserts nothing that could transfer; the question is re-posed against the target tree
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: Read alone this law is nearly vacuous, and that is deliberate: it is stated separately precisely because stating it together with non-bypassability produces a sentence that reads as enforced while only this half can be.
attrs.statement: No transition is admissible unless every support reference it used is bound into its receipt.
